name: QUT Disability and Accessibility Services
summary: Free disability advisers who arrange study adjustments, plus assistive technology rooms, for QUT students with a disability, injury or health condition.
who: Domestic or international, internal or external students with a disability, injury or health condition.
how: Contact reception on 3138 2019 or student.disability@qut.edu.au and book with your faculty's adviser, ideally before or early in your studies.
Provide current supporting documentation to receive adjustments.

evidence.quote: There is no cost for appointments with a disability adviser.
available to all students – domestic or international, internal or external.
